question: What additional petal configurations are attributed to the cakras?
premises: Sixteen-petalled and hundred-petalled forms are named
A crore-petalled form is also named
inference: The cakras may also be conceived with sixteen, hundred, or countless petals
uncertainties: The syntactic role of yathaiva ca is somewhat compressed in this enumeration
plain_english: They are also sixteen-petalled, hundred-petalled, and even crore-petalled.
